title: Metropolitan Community Health Services
description: Agape Health Services, a CCBHC/FQHC run by Metropolitan Community Health Services, offers sliding-scale primary, preventive, dental, pharmacy, and behavioral health care, plus mobile, law-enforcement, training, and reentry services. Sector: Hospitals & Physicians Clinics. Location: Washington, North Carolina. Revenue: $19.3 million. Employees: 51-200.
